{{Event infobox | location = Shipwreck Strand | type = meta event | indicator = red boss | level = 80 | id = | coordinates = [10019.4, 59408.8] | requires = VoE | map1 = Hammerhart Rumble!.jpg | map1-text = The [[Hammerhart Twins]]. }} [[Hammerhart Rumble!]] is a level 80 [[world boss]] [[meta event]] that takes place in [[Shipwreck Strand]], at [[Twisting Hollows]]. == Getting there == It is possible to get to the meta event area quickly by using the [["Found" Teleporter]] marked with {{event icon|red star}} in pub storage area near {{waypoint|Pub Canach Waypoint}}. == Dynamic events == ;Before event starts :''Twisting Hollows has grown quiet.'' ;Two minutes before the event starts :''Something strange is happening in Twisting Hollows.''
''Gather in: 2:00'' ;During the event :''Defeat Jessica and Jimmy Hammerhart before they overclock the machine.'' :{{event|Hammerhart Rumble! (event)}} ;Success :''Twisting Hollows has grown quiet.''
''Charged teleporters deactivate in 5:00'' ;Failure :''The machine will explode in''
{{event bar}} == Event schedule == The event starts every 2 hours. {{Event timer|voe-ss|style=margin-right:280px;}} == Rewards == ;Daily * One [[Magnificent Chest (Hammerhart Rumble!)|Magnificent Chest]] (once per day per account, auto-looted) * [[Bonus chest]] ** {{rewards item|Castora: Hero's Choice Chest}} (once per day per account) ** Very rare chance for: *** {{rewards item|Restless Captain Token: Coat|chance=chance|notes=chance once per day per account}} *** {{rewards item|Mini Sebb|chance=chance|notes=chance once per day per account}} ;Repeatable * Bonus chest ** {{rewards item|Piece of Rare Unidentified Gear|qty=2-4}} (or better) *** Chance for a {{rewards item|Chromatic Resin Box|chance=chance}} instead ** One of the following: *** {{rewards item|Bag of Coins|chance=chance|id=44061}} *** {{rewards item|Drip of Liquid Karma|chance=chance}} *** {{rewards item|Bead of Liquid Karma|chance=chance}} *** {{rewards item|Thimble of Liquid Karma|chance=chance}} *** {{rewards item|Shred of Castora Mastery|chance=chance}} ** {{rewards item|Chromatic Sap|qty=1|notes=doubled with [[Prosperity Unending]] mastery}} ** {{rewards item|Shipwreck Strand Renown Token|qty=1|notes=chance for 2 with [[Prosperity Unending]] mastery}} ** {{rewards item|Hammerhart's "Recovered" Hoard}} * {{rewards item|Castoran Cache of Riches|notes=with [[Natural Abundance]] mastery}} == Walkthrough == * While in the area, you are affected by {{effect|No Mount Use}}, use one of the [[Rescue Rope]]s to get up to the platform if you fall in the water. * The goal of the meta is to defeat the twin bosses, [[Captain Jessica Hammerhart|Jessica]] and [[First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart|Jimmy]]. The bosses share one health bar. When the event starts, they will spawn a protective dome around [[The Machine (object)|The Machine]]. At first, they are fought separately in their respective arenas accessed by teleports that are on the round platform by [[The Machine (object)|The Machine]]. * Each player will gain either {{effect|Magnetic Signature: Positive (player)}}, used to fight [[Captain Jessica Hammerhart|Jessica Hammerhart]] or {{effect|Magnetic Signature: Negative (player)}}, used to fight [[First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart|Jimmy Hammerhart]]. The teleporters are clearly marked with either plus or minus symbol. Fighting a boss while having the wrong Magnetic Signature will cause the player to deal no damage to the boss. * Player's Magnetic Signature will change every 25% of the boss's shared health bar, meaning every 25% they need to swap to the other boss arena. Every 25% the bosses will also spawn a protective dome around [[Southern Conduit]] and [[Northern Conduit]] that are in the middle, which need to be destroyed by breaking their cc bar. * When the bosses' hp bar reaches 25% they will both spawn back on the surface in the middle arena and will fight the last part of the fight together. * Should the event timer run out, you will have a few seconds to get off the platform and into the water before the Machine explodes, killing anyone still on it. == Dialogue == {{section-stub}} ;2 minutes before the event :'''Westergard:''' {{flavor|''Commander? Hey. Westergard. Got strange reports from Hammerhart territory. Air's crackling. Smells like...lightning.''}} :'''Westergard:''' {{flavor|''Sayida here gave me her communicator. Insists you'd help. So...help. Thanks.''}} :'''Westergard:''' {{flavor|''Your Astral Ward says their scanners are jumping. Jess'd make a deal with darkness to get us all under her thumb.''}} :'''Westergard:''' {{flavor|''And Jimmy'll do whatever she says, long as it involves explosions. Careful—those two have way more ambition than brains.''}} ;When the event starts :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Well, well, here they are. Less sense than a sunfish, eh, Jimmy? What'd I tell ya?'' :'''First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart:''' ''Well... Ya said if we act suspicious, these do-gooders'd show up. Then we'd blast 'em with them contraptions ya bought—'' :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Ah-ah! Don't ruin the surprise, Li'l Brother!'' :'''First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart:''' ''Ya said ya weren't gonna call me that no more. Ya promised!'' :'''First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart:''' ''Only seven minutes older, she is. And I'm bigger, besides—'' :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Didn't invite these louts here for tea! Fire up the machine, ya dolt!'' :'''First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart:''' ''This the part where we blow 'em up?'' :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Do I gotta do all the thinkin' 'round here? Yes, dimwit! Go!'' ;During the event :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Captain Hammerhart, Corsair Queen of Castora... Has a nice ring to it, no?'' :'''First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart:''' ''Guess so. Still get to use my cannons, right? I'll be the king o' the cannons!'' :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Prince o' the cannons. I'm seven minutes older. Said it yourself. Now shoot 'em fool!'' :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Idiot... (grunts) What did ya do?'' :'''First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart:''' ''I feel tingly...'' :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Do yer job and BLOW THIS RABBLE APART!'' :'''Westergard:''' {{flavor|''You've got to disrupt that machine— break whatever defenses they have!''}} :'''Westergard:''' {{flavor|''Readings are too high. Break through their defenses before that machine overloads!''}} :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Always gotta explain everything twice... Jimmy, pull those levers. The ones right in front of ya.'' :'''First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart:''' ''Oh! Yes, Big Sis, right! Got it!'' :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Good, good. Yes, that's it.'' :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Lettin' em break the dome again, Jimmy. I warned ya...'' :'''First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart:''' ''I'm sorry, Sis. Er...Captain. Queen Captain—'' :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''You ain't equipped to do two things at once, so stop jabberin' amd start killing'!'' :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Get your royal tail back to the main console right now, "Prince"! We need to give it everything it's got! :'''First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart:''' ''On my way, yer captain majesty!'' ;Unknown trigger :'''Westergard:''' {{flavor|''Scanner's barking! Stay away!''}} :'''Westergard:''' {{flavor|''Look out! Ward scanner's howling!''}} ;When the timer runs out :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''The power. The power! System's overloadin'! Fool! You're gonna be the death of me!'' :'''First Mate Jimmy Hammerhart:''' ''Hey! Wasn't me, Sis—'' :'''Captain Jessica Hammerhart:''' ''Shut up and run, Jimmy! It's gonna blow!'' ;Event success :'''Westergard:''' {{flavor|''Commander? Scanners are dead! Are you? No? Huh. Then I assume that's job done. Sayida was right. I'll be damned.''}} ;Event failure :(No dialogue) == Trivia == {{Anomaly|The music track ''The Hammerhearts'' spells it differently.}} * Jessica and Jimmy's names are a reference to [[w:Team_Rocket#In_the_anime|Jessie and James]], a bumbling duo of recurring antagonists from the [[w:Pokémon_(TV_series)|Pokémon anime]]. == Related achievements == * {{achievement|Hammered the Hammerharts}} * {{achievement|The Lesser-Known Leaders of Shipwreck Strand}} * {{achievement|Juke Jessica}} * {{achievement|Juke Jimmy}} * {{achievement|Alliance Field Operative: Boots on the Ground}} {{Shipwreck Strand nav}} [[de:Hammerhart-Krawall!]] [[es:¡Reyerta de los Venadoasolador!]] [[fr:Bagarre des Cerf-marteau !]]
